method: Manual visual audit of all 16 original GestioneFidi screenshots and all 16 current context crops. No OCR, transcription or external model calls.
coordinate_system: All target_bbox and context_bbox values are integer XYXY coordinates in ORIGINAL images; right and bottom are exclusive. Data-cell rectangles contain values and their internal whitespace, not glyph-tight outlines.
limitations: Readability is limited by source resolution: the three full-window base captures and two full-header tooltip captures have small native text. Do not resample or invent missing detail.
Partial header lines at the upper edge of the two 52022324 tooltip screenshots are not complete values and have null boxes.
Six noncanonical open tooltips in the whole batch are classified separately in tooltip_inventory.json.
